payout_quote: Official QKids teacher FAQ (teacher.qkids.com/faq): 'How much do I get paid? Each candidate will receive the same rate of $6 USD per trial lesson. After passing the trial classes, a final rate will be determined within a range of $6-8 USD per lesson based on your relevant educational background and/or experience, and more importantly your performance during the whole hiring process.' And: 'All teachers will be paid via bank transfer to your U.S. or Canada bank accounts. The transfer fee is covered by Qkids. The pay date is no later than the 15th of each month where you will be paid for the entire previous month of teaching.'
steps: Complete the hiring process including trial lessons ($6 USD per trial lesson).
After passing, receive a final rate of $6-$8 USD per lesson based on background and performance.
Teach scheduled lessons; paid monthly by the 15th via bank transfer (fee covered by Qkids).
catches: The $6-$8 is PER LESSON (30-minute classes), not per hour — equivalent to roughly $12-$16/hr before considering unpaid time.
You must pass trial classes at the flat $6 rate before your final rate is set.
Monthly pay (by the 15th for the prior month) — earnings are not instant.
Independent contractor; responsible for your own taxes; 6-month contract term.
biggest_catch: The $6-$8 rate is per 30-minute lesson, not per hour — and you only get paid monthly by the 15th for the prior month's teaching, so cash flow is slow.
eligibility: US/Canada bank account; teaching ability; pass QKids hiring process and trial lessons.
timing: Monthly payment by the 15th via bank transfer (US/Canada accounts).
